info.title: dverse 0.1.0-ci.120 — declarative Dataverse plugin deployment
info.description: Declarative deployment CLI for Dataverse plugins: plan/apply against the live environment. Installs the 'dverse' command.

options.name: --package
options.description:
project's <DversePluginPackage>/<DversePackageId> properties when omitted; id defaults to
the assembly name; --package-id implies --package

options.name: --no-prune
options.description: or just the named ones (steps, apis, webresources, commands), e.g.

options.name: --no-bump
options.description:
skip the automatic source-version increment on content changes
(AssemblyVersion revision / PCF manifest patch — commit the bumped files)

options.name: --rebuild
options.description:
run every configured web resource and PCF build, even the ones whose
sources and build output are unchanged since the last run

options.name: --timings
options.description:
per-stage elapsed and round-trip counts on stderr
dverse watch [--plan] [--debounce <ms>] [--all] [--no-prune] [--no-batch] [--env <name>]
converge the component that changed, on save: a saved web
resource rebuilds and diffs that set alone, not the whole repo.
schema:, seed: and the snapshot refresh are excluded, and
versions are never auto-bumped — run apply before committing
dverse adopt --assembly <name> [--env <name>] [--out <file.cs>] [--namespace <ns>] [--force]
scaffold [Step] attributes from a live assembly's registration,
Ids pinned (read-only; default prints to stdout)
dverse schema adopt --entities <a,b,…> [--out <schema/core.yaml>] [--env <name>]
emit schema YAML from live metadata (read-only): full table
declarations for prefixed tables, 'extensions:' (prefixed
columns/keys) for standard ones — adopt → plan exits 0
dverse forms pull [--entities <a,b,…>] [--env <name>] [--force]
dverse views pull [--entities <a,b,…>] [--env <name>] [--force]
capture designer-authored forms/views into the configured
'forms:'/'views:' sets as committed files (read-only; entities
default to the folders already present; pull → plan exits 0)
dverse commands pull [--env <name>] [--set <path>] [--force]
capture the modern commands each configured 'commands:' set's
prefix manages into committed YAML (read-only; pull → plan
exits 0). Commands the platform will not let dverse author
are skipped with the reason — and never pruned either
dverse webresources pull [--env <name>] [--set <path>] [--force]
download each configured set's environment web resources into its
local path (read-only; --force overwrites differing local files;
nonconforming names get a ready-to-paste 'map:' snippet)
dverse sign init [--out certs/plugins.pfx] [--subject "CN=…"] [--years 3]
[--password-env DVERSE_SIGN_PASSWORD] [--force]
create a self-signed code-signing certificate and print the
'signing:' block to add — plan/apply then Authenticode-sign
every plugin assembly before upload (required for managed identity)
dverse sign info [--env <name>]            show the configured certificate plus the exact Azure federated
credential (issuer, audience, subject identifier) to create for it
dverse debug create <entity> [col=value ...] [--env <name>]
dverse debug update <entity> <id> [col=value ...]
dverse debug delete <entity> <id>
dverse debug api <uniquename> [<boundid>] [Param=value ...]
[--debug] [--no-cascade] [--no-async] [--trace] [--max-depth <n>] [--no-build]
run the registered pipeline LOCALLY against the built
assembly: reads come from the environment, writes are
simulated and reported, nothing is written. --debug waits
for a debugger to attach so breakpoints hit on the first
run (exit 0 = succeeded, 2 = a plugin rejected it)
dverse debug ui [--port <n>] [--no-open] [--env <name>]
the same simulator as a page on 127.0.0.1: compose a run
from the snapshot's own column types, pick the row by
name, and read the step tree with each step's reads,
traces and changes under it. Local to this machine only
dverse pcf init --name <ControlName> [--namespace <ns>] [--template field|dataset] [--path <dir>] [--install]
scaffold a PCF control project (pcf-scripts layout; namespace
defaults to the name, path to pcfcontrols/<name>; --install runs
npm install) — deployed by plan/apply once listed under 'pcf:'
in dataverse.yaml

options.name: --no-prune
options.description: keep environment-only components instead of deleting them

options.name: --no-batch
options.description: one request per write instead of parallel $batch changesets

options.name: --env
options.description:
environment to converge; otherwise the usual resolution applies
not watched, by design:
schema:            metadata writes are not an inner-loop operation
seed:              declared in dataverse.yaml, which needs a restart anyway
the model snapshot is not refreshed per converge — run plan or apply for that
Versions are never auto-bumped here: incrementing AssemblyVersion on every save would
rewrite the csproj continuously. Run apply before you commit.
Stop with Ctrl+C.

options.name: --package
options.description:
project's <DversePluginPackage>/<DversePackageId> properties when omitted; id defaults to
the assembly name; --package-id implies --package

options.name: --no-prune
options.description: or just the named ones (steps, apis, webresources, commands), e.g.

options.name: --no-bump
options.description:
skip the automatic source-version increment on content changes
(AssemblyVersion revision / PCF manifest patch — commit the bumped files)

options.name: --rebuild
options.description:
run every configured web resource and PCF build, even the ones whose
sources and build output are unchanged since the last run

options.name: --timings
options.description:
per-stage elapsed and round-trip counts on stderr
dverse watch [--plan] [--debounce <ms>] [--all] [--no-prune] [--no-batch] [--env <name>]
converge the component that changed, on save: a saved web
resource rebuilds and diffs that set alone, not the whole repo.
schema:, seed: and the snapshot refresh are excluded, and
versions are never auto-bumped — run apply before committing
dverse adopt --assembly <name> [--env <name>] [--out <file.cs>] [--namespace <ns>] [--force]
scaffold [Step] attributes from a live assembly's registration,
Ids pinned (read-only; default prints to stdout)
dverse schema adopt --entities <a,b,…> [--out <schema/core.yaml>] [--env <name>]
emit schema YAML from live metadata (read-only): full table
declarations for prefixed tables, 'extensions:' (prefixed
columns/keys) for standard ones — adopt → plan exits 0
dverse forms pull [--entities <a,b,…>] [--env <name>] [--force]
dverse views pull [--entities <a,b,…>] [--env <name>] [--force]
capture designer-authored forms/views into the configured
'forms:'/'views:' sets as committed files (read-only; entities
default to the folders already present; pull → plan exits 0)
dverse commands pull [--env <name>] [--set <path>] [--force]
capture the modern commands each configured 'commands:' set's
prefix manages into committed YAML (read-only; pull → plan
exits 0). Commands the platform will not let dverse author
are skipped with the reason — and never pruned either
dverse webresources pull [--env <name>] [--set <path>] [--force]
download each configured set's environment web resources into its
local path (read-only; --force overwrites differing local files;
nonconforming names get a ready-to-paste 'map:' snippet)
dverse sign init [--out certs/plugins.pfx] [--subject "CN=…"] [--years 3]
[--password-env DVERSE_SIGN_PASSWORD] [--force]
create a self-signed code-signing certificate and print the
'signing:' block to add — plan/apply then Authenticode-sign
every plugin assembly before upload (required for managed identity)
dverse sign info [--env <name>]            show the configured certificate plus the exact Azure federated
credential (issuer, audience, subject identifier) to create for it
dverse debug create <entity> [col=value ...] [--env <name>]
dverse debug update <entity> <id> [col=value ...]
dverse debug delete <entity> <id>
dverse debug api <uniquename> [<boundid>] [Param=value ...]
[--debug] [--no-cascade] [--no-async] [--trace] [--max-depth <n>] [--no-build]
run the registered pipeline LOCALLY against the built
assembly: reads come from the environment, writes are
simulated and reported, nothing is written. --debug waits
for a debugger to attach so breakpoints hit on the first
run (exit 0 = succeeded, 2 = a plugin rejected it)
dverse debug ui [--port <n>] [--no-open] [--env <name>]
the same simulator as a page on 127.0.0.1: compose a run
from the snapshot's own column types, pick the row by
name, and read the step tree with each step's reads,
traces and changes under it. Local to this machine only
dverse pcf init --name <ControlName> [--namespace <ns>] [--template field|dataset] [--path <dir>] [--install]
scaffold a PCF control project (pcf-scripts layout; namespace
defaults to the name, path to pcfcontrols/<name>; --install runs
npm install) — deployed by plan/apply once listed under 'pcf:'
in dataverse.yaml
